resources.string: Someone took the pie from the pie stall and is sneaking along the market lane to the back gate. The thief is one of the animals in the lineup.
On your turn, pick a clue to look for: a hat, glasses, a scarf, a bag, boots or a bow tie. Then hold the magic lens to peek at the answer.
Tell your friends what you saw in your own words, then tap Show everyone. Together, tap every animal that does not match the clue to clear it.
After each clue the thief may sneak a hop closer to the back gate. The fewer clues you need, the more stars you earn. A Sidekick can give hints or take a turn.
When only one animal is left, or you are sure, tap Catch! and then the thief. Everyone wins or tries again together.
A magnifying glass works because curved glass bends light, so a small thing looks bigger.
Pick a clue, hold the magic lens to peek, then tell your friends what you saw.
Tap every animal that does not match the clue. They are not the thief.
Stuck? Tap the Sidekick hint. Catch the thief before it reaches the back gate.
